question.text: Will Ukraine have de facto control of Dobropillia, Donetsk on December 31, 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as **Yes** if, when accessed by Metaculus on December 31, 2026, the Institute for the Study of War (ISW) reports via its [Interactive Map](https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/36a7f6a6f5a9448496de641cf64bd375) its assessment that the main administrative services [building](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Tsentr+Nadannya+Administratyvnykh+Posluh/@48.4599113,37.0782893,454m/data=!3m1!1e3!4m6!3m5!1s0x40de52822075f5ad:0xe002f062b3ed9efd!8m2!3d48.4599113!4d37.0808642!16s%2Fg%2F11f3y2j9q9?entry=ttu\&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MTEwMy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) of Dobropillia, found at coordinates 48.45985 N, 37.081 E, is under Ukraine's control.
question.fine_print:
DETAILED INSTRUCTIONS:

1. Go to the Institute for the Study of War and AEI Critical Threats Project [map page](https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/36a7f6a6f5a9448496de641cf64bd375).
2. Scroll down to the interactive map.
3. If the search box is not visible, click the 'X' on the top of the legend overlay on the left side of the map to close it.
4. Paste these coordinates into the search box: 48.45985 N, 37.081 E

If the location is marked on the map as Russian-controlled on that date, then this question resolves as **No**. Using ISW's map legend conventions as of November 7, 2026, this means "Assessed Russian Advances" or "Assessed Russian Control," shaded in solid pink.

For purposes of this question, territory encompassing that location that is not assessed by ISW as under Russian control according to the map legend counts as being under Ukrainian control. This includes unshaded areas, "Assessed Russian Infiltration Areas" and "Claimed Russian Territory."

If ISW offers new labels or descriptions to indicate Russia's assessed territorial control or assessed advances in the area, those will also apply.

In the event of issues with the main resolution source such as substantial controversy about its accuracy at the target date, Metaculus may consult other [<u>credible sources</u>](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) to resolve the question.

# Dobropillia (Donetsk): research summary as of 2026-11-16

As of 2026-11-15, nothing settles this question. ISW's latest text still treats Dobropillia as Ukrainian-held: it reports Russian infiltration near the town and no Russian advance. Russia's claim to have captured the town in October has been denied and debunked. Pressure is very heavy, though: about 40% of all clashes on the front line are in this sector, and Russia has begun mechanized assaults. Polymarket puts the chance of Russia capturing the town by December 31 at 13.5%.

## 1. Resolution source
- I could not read the ISW/CTP StoryMaps ArcGIS map directly; the page is built by scripts. So I have no machine-read status for the building at 48.45985 N, 37.081 E. The best proxies are ISW's daily text and the Metaculus screenshot.
- 2026-11-07: According to the question background, ISW's map showed assessed Russian advances less than 5 km from the building. [Metaculus](https://www.metaculus.com/questions/46464)
- 2026-11-15: ISW wrote that Russian forces "continued intense offensive operations in the Dobropillya direction, accounting for around 40 percent of all combat engagements across the frontline, on November 14 and 15 but did not advance." [ISW Nov 15](https://understandingwar.org/research/russia-ukraine/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-november-15-2026/)
- Watch out for a namesake: the ISW Nov 15 report also mentions a different "Dobropillya" in Zaporizhia Oblast, which is not the town in this question.

## 2. Current status
- No resolving event yet. ISW's text treats the town as Ukrainian-held, with Russian infiltration only.
- 2026-11-01: ISW said Russian forces had made limited gains toward the town but "have not consolidated any positions in the town." [ISW Nov 1](https://understandingwar.org/research/russia-ukraine/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-november-1-2026/)
- 2026-11-13: DeepState put 8% of Dobropillia's administrative area in the grey zone, up from 4% (the southern part plus the eastern outskirts). It said the rest is firmly held by Ukrainian forces. [real-vin/DeepState](https://real-vin.com/voroh-prorvavsia-na-skhidni-okolytsi-dobropillia-deepstate)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-16: DeepState reported Russian advances near Rusyn Yar (Kostiantynivka direction) and Bilytske (Dobropillia direction). I could not open the article; the site returned 403. [comments.ua](https://comments.ua/uk/news/society/novyy-proryv-frontu-deepstate-povidomyv-tryvozni-novyny-813483.html)
- 2026-11-15: DeepState assessed that Russia is trying to bypass Dobropillia rather than storm it head-on. [zn.ua](https://zn.ua/ukr/war/704012-rosijani-prosunulisja-na-kilkokh-naprjamkakh-deepstate.html)
- 2026-11-15: ISW called the Kremlin's proposed local ceasefire in Kostiantynivka a ploy to help capture that city and Dobropillia. It also cited Russian milbloggers complaining about a "fictitious frontline trace" built on exaggerated claims. [24tv](https://24tv.ua/pastka-dlya-zahoplennya-dvoh-mist-isw-rozkrili-metu-peremirya_n3180687), [ISW Nov 15](https://understandingwar.org/research/russia-ukraine/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-november-15-2026/)
- 2026-11-14: Euromaidan Press reported a rare Russian mechanized attack in fog on November 13. Ukraine claimed 14 vehicles hit. One analyst said no Ukrainian positions were lost but some Russian infantry may be hiding near the line. [Euromaidan Press](https://euromaidanpress.com/2026/11/14/eastern-fog/)
- 2026-11-13: ISW reported:
  - Russian flag-raisings in western Shylivka (southwest of the town), which ISW assesses were infiltration missions.
  - A strike on a Russian position in western Rubizhne (northeast).
  - A platoon-sized mechanized assault toward Hruzke.
  - Heavy equipment being deployed "toward Dobropillya itself" to exploit poor drone weather.

  [ISW Nov 13](https://understandingwar.org/research/russia-ukraine/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-november-13-2026/)
- 2026-11-08: DeepState recorded the first Russian breakthrough to the southern outskirts (3% grey zone). [my.ua](https://my.ua/uk/news/cluster/2026-11-08-okupanti-prorvalisia-na-okolitsi-dobropillia)
- 2026-11-06: The WSJ reported Russian troops outnumber Ukrainians about 6 to 1 locally, and that about a third of Russia's elite Rubicon drone force is in this sector. [WSJ](https://www.wsj.com/world/russia/ten-months-of-war-to-gain-46-square-miles-how-russia-is-failing-on-the-battlefield-3184ae10)
- 2026-10-16 to 10-20: Russian Chief of the General Staff Gerasimov claimed "full control" of the town, and Putin echoed it. Zelensky and Ukraine's General Staff denied it, the Russian video was called AI-generated or edited, and ISW still had the town under Ukrainian control. [Radio Svoboda](https://www.radiosvoboda.org/a/dobropillya-navishcho-rosiya-zayavlyaye-pro-kontrol/33880157.html)
- Wikipedia repeats the Russian claim and calls the town "under heavy fighting." It is not reliable on control status. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dobropillia)

## 4. Base rates
- The Russian offensive toward Dobropillia began 2025-08-11, and urban fighting started around July 2026. In roughly 15 months Russia has reached only the outskirts, with ISW recording infiltration rather than control. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dobropillia)
- In comparable towns (Pokrovsk, Kostiantynivka), ISW typically marked central buildings as Russian-controlled only months after infiltration first reached the outskirts. That comparison is my own and I found no source quantifying it. The building in question is in the town centre, about 5 km from ISW's nearest assessed advance on November 7.
- On a related note, a 2026-11-15 analysis by OSINT expert Clément Molin says Ukraine holds the initiative on about half the front, while Russia concentrates its effort on Dobropillia and Kostiantynivka. [charter97](https://charter97.org/ru/news/2026/11/15/705636/)

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket, "Will Russia capture Dobropillia by...?", prices as of 2026-11-16:

  | Deadline | Yes |
  |---|---|
  | November 30 | 3.9% |
  | December 31 | 13.5% |
  | March 31, 2027 | 42.5% |
  | October 31 | 0% (resolved No) |

  The market's resolution source may differ from ISW's map, which I did not verify.
- I found no Metaculus community forecast visible here, and no Kalshi or Manifold market on this question. The Kalshi markets in the supplied list are unrelated.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Fog and winter weather that reduce drone effectiveness, which ISW and Euromaidan Press flag as Russia's window for mechanized assaults.
- Possible Russian attempts to cut supply by reaching Sviatohorivka (northwest) and Hannivka (northeast), according to Playfra analysts. [Radio Svoboda](https://www.radiosvoboda.org/a/dobropillya-navishcho-rosiya-zayavlyaye-pro-kontrol/33880157.html)
- The Kremlin's Kostiantynivka ceasefire proposal and US-mediated talks, including reports of a US land-for-NATO proposal (from an unreliable forum post), which could freeze or change front lines.
- ISW's daily updates and map refreshes through December 30.

# Dobropillia (Donetsk): research summary as of 2026-11-16

## 1. Resolution source
- I could not read the ISW/AEI ArcGIS StoryMap directly because it is built entirely with scripts, so I can't confirm what colour the map currently shows at 48.45985 N, 37.081 E. The ISW daily text reports are the best proxy.
- 2026-11-07: Metaculus's screenshot of the ISW map showed assessed Russian advances less than 5 km from the administrative services building. [Metaculus](https://www.metaculus.com/questions/46464)
- 2026-11-15: ISW said Russian forces "continued intense offensive operations in the Dobropillya direction, accounting for around 40 percent of all combat engagements across the frontline, on November 14 and 15 but did not advance." [ISW](https://understandingwar.org/research/russia-ukraine/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-november-15-2026/)
- 2026-11-14: ISW said "Russian forces have also been unable to seize Dobropillya despite Russian Ministry of Defense (MoD) claims that Russian forces encircled and then seized the town." [ISW](https://understandingwar.org/research/russia-ukraine/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-november-14-2026/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. As of 2026-11-15, ISW reports no Russian advance and no consolidated Russian position inside the town, so the building is most likely still unshaded, which counts as Ukrainian control.
- 2026-10-16: Russia claimed full control of the city. ISW rejects this claim. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dobropillia)
- 2026-11-14: A flashback.org forum post claimed Dobropillia had been captured. It is unreliable and contradicts ISW.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-16: DeepState reported Russian advances near Rusyn Yar (Kostiantynivka axis) and Bilytske, southeast of Dobropillia, with the grey zone growing. [comments.ua](https://comments.ua/uk/news/society/novyy-proryv-frontu-deepstate-povidomyv-tryvozni-novyny-813483.html)
- 2026-11-14: ISW assessed that the Kremlin's proposed local ceasefire in Kostiantynivka would help Russia set conditions to seize both Kostiantynivka and Dobropillia. Russia made 47 attacks in the Dobropillia direction on Nov 13-14, the most since Nov 1. [ISW](https://understandingwar.org/research/russia-ukraine/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-november-14-2026/)
- 2026-11-14: Ukraine's 1st Separate Assault Regiment said it repelled a mechanized assault, destroying 7 vehicles and 3 ATVs and killing or wounding 30 Russian troops. [Euromaidan Press](https://euromaidanpress.com/2026/11/14/eastern-fog/)
- 2026-11-13: Russia used fog to launch a mechanized assault toward Hruzke, northeast of the town (3 tanks, 3 IFVs, more than 10 light vehicles). Geolocated footage showed a Russian flag-raising in western Shylivka, southwest of the town, which ISW assessed as an infiltration. A Ukrainian source said Russia is moving heavy equipment toward Dobropillia itself. [ISW](https://understandingwar.org/research/russia-ukraine/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-november-13-2026/)
- 2026-11-10: Russian attacks concentrated southwest of the town, with no advance. A new Russian unit (5th Separate Commandant's Regiment) was seen near Bilytske. [ISW](https://understandingwar.org/research/russia-ukraine/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-november-10-2026/)
- 2026-11-06: The WSJ reported Russian troops outnumber Ukrainian troops about 6 to 1 locally, with about a third of Russia's Rubikon drone force deployed there (as quoted in the question background; I could not open the WSJ page).
- 2026-11-01: ISW said Russia holds the initiative locally, averaging about 30 attacks a day, with only "limited gains... but have not consolidated any positions in the town." [ISW](https://understandingwar.org/research/russia-ukraine/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-november-1-2026/)

## 4. Base rates
- Russia has been within reach of Dobropillia since August 2025, and the battle for the city reportedly began around July 2026. ISW's November 1 report says this has been the highest-intensity sector since at least August 1, 2026. Even so, after roughly 3.5 months of top-priority assaults, Russia still has no assessed control in the town. [ISW](https://understandingwar.org/research/russia-ukraine/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-november-1-2026/)
- According to the WSJ headline, Russia gained about 46 square miles in ten months in its main effort, which is a very slow pace.
- ISW usually shades a town only after geolocated evidence of consolidated positions, which lags infiltrations by weeks. Reaching the town centre, about 5 km from the November 7 assessed line, within 6 weeks would be faster than recent progress in this sector.
- Something that works the other way: ISW sometimes updates its map in large batches after the fact. Bigger gains could therefore show up suddenly.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket, "Will Russia capture Dobropillia by...?" (prices as of 2026-11-16): Nov 30: 3.9% Yes; Dec 31: 13.5% Yes (86.5% No); Mar 31, 2027: 42.5% Yes. This is closely related but not identical: Polymarket's resolution rules may not use the ISW building test, and I did not check them.
- None of the Kalshi markets supplied are relevant.
- I did not find a Manifold market or published expert probabilities.

## 6. Upcoming events before Dec 31
- Winter fog and poor drone conditions favour Russian mechanized assaults, and Ukrainian commanders have warned of a fall mechanized push since mid-September. [ISW](https://understandingwar.org/research/russia-ukraine/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-november-13-2026/)
- Talks on a Kostiantynivka humanitarian ceasefire: ISW thinks a ceasefire could free Russian forces to regroup against Dobropillia. Zelensky has rejected it so far.
- US-brokered negotiations continue, with reported land-for-security proposals. A Ukrainian withdrawal under a deal could change the map, but I found no sign that one is imminent.
- Ukrainian counterattacks northeast of the town were noted on 2026-11-01, and ISW says Ukraine has taken the initiative on much of the rest of the front.

Sources: [ISW Nov 15](https://understandingwar.org/research/russia-ukraine/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-november-15-2026/), [ISW Nov 14](https://understandingwar.org/research/russia-ukraine/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-november-14-2026/), [ISW Nov 13](https://understandingwar.org/research/russia-ukraine/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-november-13-2026/), [ISW Nov 10](https://understandingwar.org/research/russia-ukraine/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-november-10-2026/), [ISW Nov 1](https://understandingwar.org/research/russia-ukraine/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-november-1-2026/), [comments.ua](https://comments.ua/uk/news/society/novyy-proryv-frontu-deepstate-povidomyv-tryvozni-novyny-813483.html), [Euromaidan Press](https://euromaidanpress.com/2026/11/14/eastern-fog/), [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dobropillia), [CriticalThreats Nov 11](https://www.criticalthreats.org/analysis/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-november-11-2026), [Militarnyi](https://militarnyi.com/en/news/russia-intensifies-offensive-on-donbas-fortress-belt-losing-more-equipment/)

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) There are about 6.5 weeks until resolution, on 2026-12-31. The question resolves Yes if, on that date, the ISW interactive map does not show the administrative services building (48.45985 N, 37.081 E) inside "Assessed Russian Advances" or "Assessed Russian Control." Unshaded areas, infiltration areas and claimed areas all count as Ukrainian control.

(b) Status quo: Yes. As of November 15, ISW reports no Russian advance and no consolidated positions in the town. On November 7, the nearest assessed advance was about 5 km from the building, which is in the town centre.

(c) Base rate: a heavily contested Ukrainian town where Russia has only infiltrated the outskirts, but where ISW has not yet shaded the centre. In such cases, the centre is rarely shaded within 6 weeks. Pokrovsk, Kostiantynivka and Toretsk each took months to go from first infiltration to an assessed centre. My base rate that the centre remains unshaded after 6 weeks is about 85-90% (Yes).

(d) Evidence for No (Russian shading):
- About 40% of all frontline engagements are in this sector (ISW, Nov 15).
- Russia has a local manpower advantage of about 6 to 1 and has deployed a third of its Rubikon drone force here (WSJ, Nov 6).
- Fog is enabling mechanized assaults (Nov 13-14).
- DeepState's grey zone inside the town grew from 3% (Nov 8) to 8% (Nov 13).
- The town has been isolated by road since the summer.
- ISW sometimes updates its map in batches.

Evidence for Yes:
- ISW reported "did not advance" (Nov 14-15) and "have not consolidated any positions in the town" (Nov 1).
- Russia's October claim to have captured the town was debunked.
- DeepState says the rest of the town is firmly held and that Russia is trying to bypass the town rather than storm it (Nov 15).
- Polymarket gives a 13.5% chance that Russia captures the town by Dec 31.

(e) No scenario: Fog and winter weather blunt Ukrainian drones. Russian mechanized pushes and infiltrations consolidate in the southern and eastern districts, and supply routes via Sviatohorivka and Hannivka collapse. Ukraine withdraws in December, and ISW shades the centre by late December.

Yes scenario: Assaults continue at high cost but produce only grey-zone gains on the outskirts. ISW keeps the centre unshaded through December 31, which is the most likely outcome.

(f) I start from about 87% and anchor on Polymarket's 86.5% No. ISW's test, a specific central building that must be shaded rather than "capture" in general, is somewhat stricter than Polymarket's likely criteria, and ISW's assessments lag events. That nudges the probability up. The growing grey zone and the mechanized pushes in bad weather keep me from going much higher.

Probability: 88%

(a) About 6.5 weeks remain, until ISW's map is checked on December 31, 2026. The question resolves Yes if the administrative services building at 48.45985 N, 37.081 E is not shaded as "Assessed Russian Advances" or "Assessed Russian Control." Unshaded, infiltration or claimed-only areas all count as Ukrainian control.

(b) The status quo is Yes. As of November 15, ISW reports no Russian advance and no consolidated Russian position in the town. The nearest assessed advance on November 7 was under 5 km from the building, and only about 8% of the town is in DeepState's grey zone.

(c) Base rate: when ISW's assessed advances sit several kilometres from a town centre, ISW has rarely shaded that centre as Russian-held within about 6 weeks. Towns like Pokrovsk and Kostiantynivka took months to go from outskirts infiltration to shaded central control. A reference-class rate for Ukraine still holding the centre after 6 weeks is about 85-90%.

(d) Evidence:
- For Yes:
  - ISW on Nov 14-15 said Russia "did not advance" and was "unable to seize Dobropillya."
  - Russia's October capture claim was debunked.
  - Russia has made slow progress over 15 months, and the WSJ (Nov 6) describes heavy losses for small gains.
  - Polymarket prices capture by Dec 31 at only 13.5%.
  - DeepState (Nov 15) says Russia is trying to bypass the town rather than storm it.
- For No:
  - About 40% of all front-line clashes are in this sector.
  - Russian troops reportedly outnumber Ukrainians 6 to 1, with about a third of the Rubikon drone force deployed there.
  - The town is cut off from road supply.
  - Russia began mechanized assaults in fog on Nov 13, and the grey zone grew from 3% to 8% between Nov 8 and Nov 13.
  - ISW sometimes updates its map in batches after the fact.
  - A deal-based Ukrainian withdrawal is a small tail risk.

(e) No scenario: winter fog blunts Ukrainian drones, and Russian mechanized and infantry pushes cut the remaining supply paths. Ukraine withdraws from the centre in December, and ISW shades the centre after geolocated footage. Yes scenario: Russia keeps infiltrating the southern and eastern outskirts and attempts a bypass, but ISW only marks infiltration areas, so the centre stays unshaded through December 31.

(f) I start at roughly 87% from the base rate and the Polymarket complement (86.5%). The ISW building test is stricter than general "capture," because ISW must assess a consolidated advance at the town centre, and ISW lags events. That nudges me up slightly. The rising intensity, the mechanized attacks and the town's isolation pull me back down. Net, I land slightly above the market.

Probability: 88%

(a) About 6.5 weeks remain, until ISW's map is checked on December 31, 2026. For Yes, ISW's interactive map must not show the administrative services building (48.45985 N, 37.081 E) as "Assessed Russian Advances" or "Assessed Russian Control." Unshaded, infiltration-only or claimed-only all count as Ukrainian.

(b) Status quo: Yes. As of the November 13-15 ISW reports, Russia has no consolidated positions in the town and "did not advance." The nearest ISW-assessed advance was under 5 km from the building on November 7.
